question: Does the production birth-age slope remain after exact saturation-index and translation-invariant birth-site-pair Smith-class fixed effects?

risk_and_outcome.orientation: fit first and second separately; retain their common-batch covariance

site_class_justification: Every production quotient has HNF [[N,h12],[0,1]] and Smith invariants [1,N], so site labels are one cyclic coordinate. gcd(delta_site,N) is invariant under translation, sign, and cyclic-generator changes and gives the minimal exact Smith order class of the two birth sites.
estimator: Within every frozen stratum, center integer age steps by survivor-count mean and fit the same one-degree linear-probability slope used at 2e99533; no interaction, nonlinear basis, model selection, or flexible learner.
identifiability_gate: A controlled slope is mechanism-interpretable only if its summed within-stratum age denominator is at least 25 percent of the primary line-only denominator in every orientation; otherwise report underidentified.

covariance.delete_one: remove one common batch index simultaneously from first and second orientations and recompute all three slopes
covariance.cross_size: zero because N325 and N425 use disjoint seeds and replica domains

scores.replay: primary point/covariance must reproduce 2e99533 before new controls are interpreted
scores.individual: two-sided Student t with 99 df for each controlled slope and paired difference from primary
scores.archive_joint: two-degree covariance-aware Wald score of the two orientation slopes, reported once per size
scores.attenuation: report beta_control-beta_primary, absolute-magnitude retention abs(beta_control)/abs(beta_primary), and age-denominator retention

decision_rule: The strong age association survives a control when the identifiability gate passes and its two-orientation joint p is below 0.01. Controls are nested diagnostics on the same archives, never independent evidence votes.

temporal_boundary.iota12_site12: future/outcome-side relative to the k0 risk-set prediction
temporal_boundary.interpretation: The full pair control can diagnose omitted two-birth embedding structure but cannot establish a predictive state available at k0 or support a causal mediation claim.

claim_boundary: A surviving controlled slope still rejects only lumpability of the recorded coarse state and may proxy unrecorded current geometry.
Attenuation under the site-pair control is descriptive because second-birth fields are future relative to k0.
iota support may be exactly degenerate at one under the integral saturation theorem; if so, report that exact no-op rather than inventing an index effect.
No new Monte Carlo is authorized.
